newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Max says share rise reflects new ventures.
newsitem.headline: Max says share rise reflects new ventures.

text.p: Max Resources Ltd said on Tuesday that the recent rise in its shares reflected increasing market awareness of its new organic fertiliser business ventures.
The New Zealand Stock Exchange asked Max if it was aware of special factors behind the rise of its shares to NZ$0.80 on March 21 from $0.49 on February 3.

"It is our belief that the market is fully informed of our activities and that the price of Max shares is reflecting an increasing awareness of the matters contained in our recent announcements concerning the proposed change of business of the

"It is also possible that over the past three months the market has re-rated the value of our gold exploration assets/investments in view of continued exploration success and increased share market values."
Max holds 28 percent of Intrepid Mining Corporation and about 14 percent of the existing resource base at the Norseman gold project in Western Australia.
The company has said it intends to realise its gold assets over time to focus on the manufacture of organic fertiliser in the United States, France, Indonesia, India and Sri Lanka.
